headline: US Commerce Department Revises Q3 Annualized Growth Up to 4.3%
summary: The US Commerce Department revised third-quarter annualized GDP growth up to 4.3% from the initial 3.4% estimate, prompting political debate over the timing of the release.
why: GDP growth revisions provide crucial baseline data for assessing overall US economic health and future Federal Reserve monetary policy paths.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: An upward revision to Q3 annualized GDP indicates stronger underlying economic activity.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The Bureau of Economic Analysis published an upward revision to economic growth figures from 3.4% to 4.3%.
